name: Mitten Extracts 510 Cartridge | Honeydew
description: Light, crisp, and effortlessly smooth — Honeydew delivers a refreshing sweetness that never overwhelms. This mellow flavor brings a clean, cooling finish with every pull, making it the perfect all-day companion for anyone who loves fruity profiles without the punch. Easy, uplifting, and endlessly enjoyable.
